articles.title: 94 acres in Massachusetts approved for 26 homes may become a $2 million wildlife conservation area
articles.description: In Gloucester, Massachusetts, a 26-home housing initiative is meeting resistance from environmental groups. Future objectives include establishing walking trails to connect this space with adjacent conservation properties.
